The package exhibits a connected cubic graph on 50 vertices for which the minimum cardinality of a maximal matching is 15, while the independent domination number is 16, so the proposed inequality fails for this regular graph. The release also develops an exact formula-graph identity based on bilateral deficiency and a conditional order threshold for the subclass of cubic graphs with a dominating induced matching. The evidence package includes the graph in multiple encodings, explicit witnesses, a proof-tree certificate, exhaustive deterministic checks, source code, a pinned container definition, and a machine-readable claim and assurance map.
